{{Quote|We have the biggest collection of droids parts between here and the desert rim. In fact, I just sold a bunch of this ''junk'' to the Empire.|The warehouse owner|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Mandalorian''' owned a warehouse in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. From the warehouse, the woman operated a [[Keldabe warehouse store|store]] selling used [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts and specialty equipment. She employed a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] to staff the lobby desk of her business, though she was willing to personally show a prospective customer around the warehouse's stock. Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Den Dhur]] and his droid companion [[I-5YQ]] came into the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] woman's store seeking parts to upgrade the [[5YQ-series protocol droid]]. She showed the two around the interior of the warehouse and negotiated a deal with Dhur to provide an additional sales manifest for items recently sold to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TLJ" />

The Mandalorian woman was tall and dark skinned, with vivid red-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. While working around her warehouse business, she dressed in a full [[Body glove/Legends|body suit]] of what Den Dhur believed to be black [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified owner of a Keldabe warehouse first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the novel [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], co-written by [[Author/Legends|authors]] [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]], and published [[February 26]], [[2013]].
